releases.name: v1.2.0 — P4 Selective Enforcement & Token Optimization
releases.body:
## in v1.2.0

### Selective Enforcement (Hybrid Gate)
- **Zero Overhead on Clear Tasks**: Eliminates the mandatory `disambiguator_assess` roundtrip for clear, deterministic requests. In `soft` mode, bounded single-file operations execute directly without extra API latency or token expenditure.
- **Selective Runtime Tool Gate**:
  - Read-only tools (`read`, `grep`, `find`) pass freely without toll.
  - Mutating tools (`edit`, `write`) are held if pending questions exist.
  - In `strict` mode or upon policy assumptions, prompts for explicit confirmation via `ctx.ui.confirm` before modifying files.
  - Shell commands and unbounded operations remain protected under explicit verification.
- **Interactive TUI Modals**: Reuses Pi's native selection dialogs (`ctx.ui.select`, `ctx.ui.input`), phase triage (architecture/scope before styling), and compaction/abort life-cycle handling.

### Token Optimization & Cache Efficiency
- **Streamlined Skills**:
  - `disambiguator-strict`: Reduced from 19.7 KB to ~740 B (~180 tokens, **-96.2%**).
  - `disambiguator-soft`: Reduced from 19.7 KB to ~1.08 KB (~260 tokens, **-94.5%**).
- **Prompt Deduplication (`stripV1Prompt`)**: Automatically strips duplicate V1 Markdown instructions when `AGENTS.md` or environment rules are already injected, saving ~5,000 tokens per call.
- **Result Compaction (`compactContent`)**: Emits compact 38-byte JSON tool results for resolved assessments, saving 70–80% of context tokens.

releases.name: v1.1.0 — Hardened Runtime Modes, Prompt Discovery, and Fail-Closed Benchmark
releases.body:
### Summary of Changes

#### 1. Canonical Contract & Prompt
- **Read-Only Discovery**: Explicitly permit inspecting workspace context to resolve ambiguity without executing modifying tools.
- **Soft Mode Expansion**: Include low-risk Type B scope adjustments alongside Type C defaults.
- **Bare Command Semantics**: Standardize `/disambiguator` with no arguments to act as `status`.
- **Deterministic Action**: Require direct tool execution for deterministic requests and defer mixed prompt execution until ambiguities resolve.
- **Wording Tightening**: Replace conflicting "industry-standard" assumption wording with Option `a` (most conservative and reversible).

#### 2. Runtime Integrations
- **OpenCode Plugin**: Rewrite preinjected headers (`# MODE: strict|soft|off`) to track active mode, neutralize preinjected prompts on `off`, and accurately log persistence errors.
- **Pi Extension**: Display session-level notifications when global persistence fails while keeping session state active.
- **Antigravity Hook**: Inject ephemeral notice on global persistence failure and remove unused workspace helpers.
- **CLI Mode Switcher**: Restrict to at most one argument (exit code 1 on extras) and detect checkout via directory identity.

#### 3. Synchronized Adapters & Parity
- Generate both `hooks.json` and `.agents/hooks.json` from a single manifest constant.
- Automatically derive version frontmatter across skill files from `package.json`.
- All 22 harness adapters synchronized and validated against `system-prompt.md`.

#### 4. Benchmark Integrity & Test Battery
- Enforce fail-closed validation on all 7 benchmark assertion keys.
- Add operational mode indicators (`Mode: strict|soft|off`) per test case.
- Separate semantic failures from transport errors (`status: ERROR`).
- Embed SHA-256 provenance hashes in benchmark runner output.

#### 5. Documentation
- Document host integration state matrix, storage locations, and token costs.
- Enumerate all 5 skill variants.

### Disambiguator

**Disambiguator** is a zero-dependency, pure instruction cognitive gatekeeper for AI coding agents. It halts the model **before any tool execution or destructive code modification**, categorizes ambiguity, and surfaces realistic **multiple-choice suggestions (a/b/c/d)** so you can steer your agent with a single letter instead of writing essays.

Eliminate wasted tokens, hallucinated architectures, and silent drift from vague instructions like *"make the UI look nice"* or *"refactor the backend"*.

---

### Capabilities

- **Runtime Mode Control**: Toggle on the fly between **`strict`** (default: halt on all ambiguities), **`soft`** (assume safest paths for conventions), and **`off`** without editing repository files.
- **Universal Multi-Harness Parity**: Synchronized across 20 adapters with guaranteed zero drift:
  - **Tier 1 (Native Hooks)**: Antigravity CLI (`agy`) & IDE, Pi Agent Harness, OpenCode Plugin.
  - **Tier 2 (Universal Rules)**: OpenChamber, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline / Roo-Code, VS Code, GitHub Copilot Chat, Kiro.
  - **Tier 3 (Assisted Memory & Skills)**: Claude Code (`CLAUDE.md` + plugin), Aider (`--read AGENTS.md`), and universal agent skills (`npx skills add agmonetti/disambiguator`).
